theorem moduleCup_hzero_identification (F G : C) (P : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (p : P ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor C 0).obj F)
    [P.IsStrictlyLE 0] [QuasiIso p]
    (_hflat : ∀ i : ℤ, ObjectProperty.flat (P.X i)) :

      (((tensorRight G).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map p) 0)

title: H-zero of a nonpositive termwise-flat tensor model
statement: Let C be a braided closed monoidal abelian category with monoidal additivity. Let F,G be objects of C, P an integer cochain complex strictly supported in degrees ≤0, and p:P→F[0] a quasi-isomorphism. Assume every P^i is flat. Then the termwise tensor-with-G map induced by p is an isomorphism on degree-zero homology.

source.place: Derived tensor flat-model construction; degree-zero cokernel calculation by right exactness

proof.text: Monoidal closedness gives colimit preservation for tensorLeft G. Transport it along BraidedCategory.tensorLeftIsoTensorRight G using Mathlib preservesColimits_of_natIso to obtain preservation of cokernels by tensorRight G.

The degree-zero short complexes of P and singleFunctor C 0 applied to F have zero outgoing differential: their degree-one objects are zero by CochainComplex.isZero_of_isStrictlyLE. Mathlib Functor.preservesRightHomology_of_zero_g therefore gives preservation of their right homology by tensorRight G.

Use quasiIsoAt_iff to extract the quasi-isomorphism of degree-zero short complexes from QuasiIso p. Apply Mathlib ShortComplex.quasiIso_map_of_preservesRightHomology. The mapped short-complex morphism is definitionally the degree-zero short-complex morphism of the termwise mapped p; quasiIsoAt_iff_isIso_homologyMap gives the stated IsIso.

proof_origin.place: Degree-zero cokernel calculation from the original node, implemented with Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.ShortComplex.PreservesHomology (preservesRightHomology_of_zero_g and quasiIso_map_of_preservesRightHomology)
